subject: SIG: consolidated compliance artifacts and next steps for CureSoft procurement
messages:
From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@curesoft.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG: final evidence needed for procurement - CureSoft

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for walking us through the platform yesterday. Our procurement team is ready to move forward but has one final gating item: they need the completed SIG responses and a small bundle of artifacts to close the security review. Specifically they asked for:

- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted if needed) and the control mapping or summary
- Executive summary of the most recent penetration test (high/critical issues summary + remediation status)
- ISO statements (scope + certificate or self-attestation)
- A short security deck we can circulate internally (2-3 slides focused on controls and data flows)

Can you share these by EOD Friday? Procurement will confirm once they have all items and then we can push to contract. If anything needs to be redacted or routed to a secure share, let me know — we can receive via secure Drive link.

Cc'ing our procurement address so they see the ask.

Appreciate the help — Tom
Tom Hayes
Head of IT Procurement, CureSoft
procurement@curesoft.com
From: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: SIG: final evidence needed for procurement - CureSoft

Team — forwarding CureSoft's request. Timeline: EOD Friday is tight but achievable if we split tasks. Proposed owners:

- Rishi: pull SOC 2 Type II report and control summary; redact as needed for customer distribution.
- Karthik: pen test executive summary + remediation status (we can redact vuln details, provide severity matrix).
- Marissa: security deck (2 slides + one architecture/dataflow) and package the Drive link + instructions for access.
- Olga (me): review package, sign-off, and upload to secure folder; liaise with CureSoft on any redaction notes.

Please confirm ownership and ETA by 12:00 PST today so I can reply to Tom. Note: if the SOC report needs a separate NDA or secure exchange, flag it now.

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2027 15:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG: final evidence needed for procurement - CureSoft

Confirmed — I'll take SOC2 and pen test summary. Quick notes:

- SOC 2 Type II: we will provide the summary PDF (Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026_summary.pdf). Full report available under NDA; summary includes period (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31) and control coverage.
- Pen test: executive summary with remediation status attached as a text stub (Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2026.txt). The full technical appendix is internal only; summary lists high/critical fixes closed and planned follow-ups.
- ISO: attaching ISO27001 statement (ISO27001_Statement_2025.pdf) — note our full cert is scoped to hosted platform only.

Attaching stubs here (files attached below). Marissa — once you have the deck, I'll add short bullets to the SOC and pen-test notes so they line up with the slides.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026_summary.pdf (attachment stub), Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2026.txt (attachment stub), ISO27001_Statement_2025.pdf (attachment stub)

—Rishi
From: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@curesoft.com>, procurement@curesoft.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2027 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG: consolidated compliance artifacts and next steps for CureSoft procurement

Tom / CureSoft team —

Thanks for the clear list. We have assembled the requested artifacts and uploaded them to a secure Drive folder. Links and brief notes below:

- Drive folder (view only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodSIGShare
  - Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026_summary.pdf (redacted summary; full report available under NDA)
  - Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2026.txt (executive summary; technical appendix internal only)
  - ISO27001_Statement_2025.pdf (scope and attestation)
  - Redwood_Security_Deck_v3_2027.pdf (2-slide executive + 1 architecture slide)

Notes:
- SOC 2 period: Jan 1, 2026 — Dec 31, 2026. The summary includes control coverage and our change management and incident response highlights.
- Pen test: last test completed Nov 2026; critical issues found were remediated by Jan 2027. Summary indicates residual medium items with planned mitigations in Q2 2027.
- ISO certificate scope: hosted platform (multi-tenant) — if your procurement requires on-prem wording, let me know and we can provide clarifying language.

If you need the full SOC 2 report, we can exchange via a secured one-time link or execute an NDA. I have also attached the short security deck for internal circulation (Redwood_Security_Deck_v3_2027.pdf).

Next steps: Please confirm receipt of the Drive link and whether procurement wants the full SOC under NDA or the summary will suffice for contracting. Happy to hop on a quick call if procurement prefers a walkthrough.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Security_Deck_v3_2027.pdf (attachment stub)
From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@curesoft.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@curesoft.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG: consolidated compliance artifacts and next steps for CureSoft procurement

Olga — thanks, received the folder and the deck. Quick follow-up items from procurement:

1) Can you confirm the SOC 2 scope lists infrastructure and data processing for hosted API customers (we need the exact control boundary text to include in our PO paperwork)?
2) For the pen test, could you provide the date of the test and the CVSS score thresholds you treat as 'critical' vs 'high' in your remediation SLA?

If you can reply to these two points today, we can finalize the vendor risk form and move to the contracting team. Otherwise happy to accept the summary plus a short one-paragraph clarification that we can include with the PO.

Thanks again — Tom
On Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:10:00 -0800, olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com wrote:
> Forwarding this into our internal tracker for follow-up.
>
> - Olga
